## R Markdown

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
# ============================================================
# Project 1: Join WADA Testing Figures + WADA ADRV data
# Output: wada_testing_adrv_sport_year_2016_2023_joined_analysis.csv
# ============================================================


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. File paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

base_dir <- "C:/Users/Apu/Desktop/asl/rstudio files/seminar/project1/data"

input_testing <- file.path(base_dir, "wada_testing_sport_year_2016_2024_final_sport_names.csv")
input_adrv <- file.path(base_dir, "wada_adrv_sport_year_2016_2023_cleaned_for_testing_join.csv")

out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "wada_testing_adrv_2016_2023_joined_analysis")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

output_joined <- file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_adrv_sport_year_2016_2023_joined_analysis.csv")
output_validation <- file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_adrv_join_validation_summary.csv")
output_unmatched_adrv <- file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_adrv_unmatched_adrv_rows.csv")
output_testing_only <- file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_adrv_testing_rows_without_adrv_report_row.csv")


```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Helper functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

safe_div <- function(num, den) {
  if_else(!is.na(den) & den != 0, num / den, NA_real_)
}

check_duplicate_keys <- function(df, dataset_name) {
  duplicate_rows <- df %>%
    count(year, sport_clean) %>%
    filter(n > 1)
  
  if (nrow(duplicate_rows) > 0) {
    print(duplicate_rows)
    stop(paste(dataset_name, "has duplicate year + sport_clean keys."))
  }
}

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Read and prepare inputs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

testing <- read_csv(input_testing, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(year >= 2016, year <= 2023) %>%
  rename(
    testing_old_sport_names = old_sport_names,
    testing_n_source_rows = n_source_rows,
    testing_sport_group_tables = sport_group_tables,
    testing_source_reports = source_reports,
    testing_source_files = source_files,
    testing_source_level_split_issues = source_level_split_issues
  ) %>%
  mutate(testing_row_present = TRUE)

adrv <- read_csv(input_adrv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(year >= 2016, year <= 2023) %>%
  rename(
    adrv_old_sport_names = old_adrv_sport_names,
    adrv_n_source_rows = n_adrv_source_rows,
    adrv_testing_sport_match_same_year_prejoin = testing_sport_match_same_year,
    adrv_sport_raw_sources = sport_raw_sources,
    adrv_sport_category_sources = sport_category_sources,
    adrv_source_tables = source_tables,
    adrv_report_total_samples_aaf_outcome = total_samples_aaf_outcome,
    adrv_report_aaf_outcome_total = aaf_outcome_total,
    adrv_source_file = source_file,
    adrv_source_year = source_year,
    adrv_source_report = source_report
  ) %>%
  mutate(adrv_report_row_present = TRUE)

check_duplicate_keys(testing, "Testing dataset")
check_duplicate_keys(adrv, "ADRV dataset")

```

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Full join
# ------------------------------------------------------------

joined <- full_join(
  testing,
  adrv,
  by = c("year", "sport_clean")
) %>%
  mutate(
    testing_row_present = replace_na(testing_row_present, FALSE),
    adrv_report_row_present = replace_na(adrv_report_row_present, FALSE),
    match_status = case_when(
      testing_row_present & adrv_report_row_present ~ "matched",
      testing_row_present & !adrv_report_row_present ~ "testing_only_no_adrv_row",
      !testing_row_present & adrv_report_row_present ~ "adrv_only_no_testing_row",
      TRUE ~ "check"
    )
  )

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Fill ADRV counts for tested sports absent from ADRV report
# ------------------------------------------------------------

adrv_count_cols <- c(
  "medical_reasons_count",
  "no_case_to_answer_count",
  "no_sanction_count",
  "pending_count",
  "analytical_adrv_count",
  "non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated",
  "total_adrv_count_sport_allocated",
  "adrv_report_total_samples_aaf_outcome",
  "adrv_report_aaf_outcome_total"
)

joined <- joined %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(adrv_count_cols), ~ replace_na(as.numeric(.x), 0)),
    across(
      any_of(c(
        "has_aaf_outcome_data",
        "has_non_analytical_adrv_data",
        "adrv_testing_sport_match_same_year_prejoin"
      )),
      ~ replace_na(.x, FALSE)
    )
  )


```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Recalculate yearly totals, rates, shares, and mismatch metrics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

joined <- joined %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    joined_yearly_total_samples = sum(total_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    joined_yearly_total_aafs = sum(aaf_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    joined_yearly_adrv_report_aaf_outcome_total = sum(adrv_report_aaf_outcome_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    joined_yearly_analytical_adrvs = sum(analytical_adrv_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    joined_yearly_non_analytical_adrvs_sport_allocated =
      sum(non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    joined_yearly_total_adrvs_sport_allocated =
      sum(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    testing_share_recalc = safe_div(total_samples, joined_yearly_total_samples),
    aaf_share_recalc = safe_div(aaf_count, joined_yearly_total_aafs),
    adrv_share_sport_allocated_recalc =
      safe_div(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, joined_yearly_total_adrvs_sport_allocated),
    analytical_adrv_share_recalc =
      safe_div(analytical_adrv_count, joined_yearly_analytical_adrvs),
    non_analytical_adrv_share_sport_allocated_recalc =
      safe_div(non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
               joined_yearly_non_analytical_adrvs_sport_allocated),
    
    aaf_rate_per_1000_tests = safe_div(aaf_count, total_samples) * 1000,
    adrv_rate_per_1000_tests = safe_div(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, total_samples) * 1000,
    analytical_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests = safe_div(analytical_adrv_count, total_samples) * 1000,
    non_analytical_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests =
      safe_div(non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated, total_samples) * 1000,
    
    analytical_adrv_per_testing_aaf = safe_div(analytical_adrv_count, aaf_count),
    total_adrv_per_testing_aaf = safe_div(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, aaf_count),
    
    yearly_overall_aaf_rate_per_1000_tests =
      safe_div(joined_yearly_total_aafs, joined_yearly_total_samples) * 1000,
    yearly_overall_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests =
      safe_div(joined_yearly_total_adrvs_sport_allocated, joined_yearly_total_samples) * 1000,
    
    aaf_rate_index_vs_year =
      safe_div(aaf_rate_per_1000_tests, yearly_overall_aaf_rate_per_1000_tests),
    adrv_rate_index_vs_year =
      safe_div(adrv_rate_per_1000_tests, yearly_overall_adrv_rate_per_1000_tests),
    
    testing_vs_aaf_gap = aaf_share_recalc - testing_share_recalc,
    testing_vs_adrv_gap = adrv_share_sport_allocated_recalc - testing_share_recalc,
    aaf_to_testing_share_ratio = safe_div(aaf_share_recalc, testing_share_recalc),
    adrv_to_testing_share_ratio = safe_div(adrv_share_sport_allocated_recalc, testing_share_recalc),
    log2_aaf_to_testing_share_ratio = if_else(aaf_to_testing_share_ratio > 0,
                                              log2(aaf_to_testing_share_ratio), NA_real_),
    log2_adrv_to_testing_share_ratio = if_else(adrv_to_testing_share_ratio > 0,
                                               log2(adrv_to_testing_share_ratio), NA_real_),
    
    include_in_testing_rate_analysis = testing_row_present & !is.na(total_samples) & total_samples > 0,
    include_in_testing_vs_adrv_share_analysis = testing_row_present,
    adrv_values_filled_zero_from_absent_report_row =
      testing_row_present & !adrv_report_row_present,
    aaf_count_diff_testing_vs_adrv_report = aaf_count - adrv_report_aaf_outcome_total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Sort and save outputs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

joined <- joined %>%
  mutate(
    status_order = case_when(
      match_status == "matched" ~ 1,
      match_status == "testing_only_no_adrv_row" ~ 2,
      match_status == "adrv_only_no_testing_row" ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 9
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, status_order, desc(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated), desc(total_samples), sport_clean) %>%
  select(-status_order)

validation <- joined %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    testing_rows = sum(testing_row_present),
    adrv_rows = sum(adrv_report_row_present),
    matched_rows = sum(match_status == "matched"),
    testing_only_rows = sum(match_status == "testing_only_no_adrv_row"),
    adrv_only_rows = sum(match_status == "adrv_only_no_testing_row"),
    total_samples = sum(total_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    testing_aaf_count = sum(aaf_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    adrv_report_aaf_outcome_total = sum(adrv_report_aaf_outcome_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    analytical_adrv_count = sum(analytical_adrv_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated =
      sum(non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_adrv_count_sport_allocated =
      sum(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    testing_share_sum = sum(testing_share_recalc, na.rm = TRUE),
    aaf_share_sum = sum(aaf_share_recalc, na.rm = TRUE),
    adrv_share_sum = sum(adrv_share_sport_allocated_recalc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(joined, output_joined)
write_csv(validation, output_validation)
write_csv(joined %>% filter(match_status == "adrv_only_no_testing_row"), output_unmatched_adrv)
write_csv(joined %>% filter(match_status == "testing_only_no_adrv_row"), output_testing_only)

print(validation)
cat("\nJoined analysis file saved to:\n", output_joined, "\n")

```
